message.content: On the jam session scheduled for April 5th, 2026 (20260405), Li Hua suggested playing "Viva la Vida" by Coldplay. This song was chosen because Li Hua believed it would be fun to play and would be enjoyable for the group. Wolfgang Schulz agreed enthusiastically, stating it was a "great song" and looking forward to jamming together. Yuriko Yamamoto also expressed her love for the song, indicating she was excited to play it as well.
